scientific limitations/integrity: The result is an explicit counterexample to the asserted necessity of \(r_\Delta(\chi)=1\) in Lemma 4.8 and Theorem 4.12(1) of the cited preprint. It does not claim that the orbit-closure part of Lemma 4.8, the sufficiency direction, or a suitably revised numerical criterion is false. The proof is direct over \(\mathbf C\) and uses only the source definitions and Hopf-algebra identities.
title: A finite-kernel counterexample to the stated super-GIT semistability criterion
